EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, Lakshman Kiriella,Minister of Higher Education and Highways, having obtained a report under Section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respectof the National School of Business Management Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, No. 7 of2007 and bearing registration number PB 4833, do by this Order, amend the schedule to Order made under the said Act,and published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1975/48 of July 14, 2016 by the addition immediately after the entry “Bachelorof Management Honours in Accounting and Finance” appearing in Column I and it’s corresponding entry in Column IIrespectively in the Schedule II thereof, of the entries specified under Column I and Column II respectively of the ScheduleII hereto, subject of the conditions specified I hereto :–

National School of Business Management Limited shall, when admitting students for the degree programme specified inSchedule II hereto in respect of the Bachelor of Science Honours in Computer System Engineering, adhere to the minimumentry qualifications of three (03) ‘S’ passes in Physical Science stream in one and the same sitting at the GCE AdvanceLevel Examination or equivalent.
Column IColumn IIDegreeAbbreviation of the Degree
Bachelor of Science Honours in ComputerBScHons (Computer System Engineering)System Engineering
LAKSHMAN KIRIELLA,Minister of Higher Education and Highways.Colombo,10th January 2018.
